content: BIBREF21 investigate the understanding of function words – among them negation particles – using an entailment- and classification-based approach. They analyze the ability of different model architectures and training objectives to capture knowledge of single sentences. The models are fine-tuned to the task of interest. We on the other hand question to what extend factual knowledge present in negated statements is indirectly acquired during pretraining.
